result.topic_en: Lambert-series formulas for powers of theta-type functions giving the number of representations of a number as a sum of 2, 4, 6 and 8 squares or triangular numbers, and for powers of the binary quadratic-form series S = Σ x^{μ²+μν+ν²}.
result.transcription:
Add.Ms a 94 18(97) (97) (6)
(3.12) $\phi^4(x) = 1 + 8\left(\frac{x}{1-x} + \frac{2x^2}{1+x^2} + \frac{3x^3}{1-x^3} + \cdots\right)$
(3.13) $\phi^6(x) = 1 - 4\left(\frac{1^2 x}{1-x} - \frac{3^2 x^3}{1-x^3} + \frac{5^2 x^5}{1-x^5} - \cdots\right)$
$+ 16\left(\frac{1^2 x}{1+x^2} + \frac{2^2 x^2}{1+x^4} + \frac{3^2 x^3}{1+x^6} + \cdots\right)$
(3.14) $\phi^8(x) = 1 + 16\left(\frac{1^3 x}{1+x} + \frac{2^3 x^2}{1-x^2} + \frac{3^3 x^3}{1+x^3} + \cdots\right)$
(3.21) $x^{\frac14}\psi^2(x) = \frac{x^{\frac14}}{1-x^{\frac12}} - \frac{x^{\frac34}}{1-x^{\frac32}} + \frac{x^{\frac54}}{1-x^{\frac52}} - \cdots$
(3.22) $x^{\frac12}\psi^4(x) = \frac{x^{\frac12}}{1-x} + \frac{3x^{\frac32}}{1-x^3} + \frac{5x^{\frac52}}{1-x^5} + \cdots$
(3.23) $x^{\frac34}\psi^6(x) = \frac{1}{16}\left(\frac{1^2 x^{\frac14}}{1+x^{\frac12}} + \frac{3^2 x^{\frac34}}{1+x^{\frac32}} + \frac{5^2 x^{\frac54}}{1+x^{\frac52}} + \cdots\right)$
$- \frac{1}{16}\left(\frac{1^2 x^{\frac14}}{1-x^{\frac12}} - \frac{3^2 x^{\frac34}}{1-x^{\frac32}} + \frac{5^2 x^{\frac54}}{1-x^{\frac52}} - \cdots\right)$
(3.24) $x\psi^8(x) = \frac{1^3 x}{1-x^2} + \frac{2^3 x^2}{1-x^4} + \frac{3^3 x^3}{1-x^6} + \cdots$
These are of course well known formulae for the
number of representations of a number as the sum
of 2, 4, 6 and 8 squares or triangular numbers.
There are also various other arithmetical problems
in which the partition method gives the actual value.
I shall quote a few examples and reserve the dis-
cussion of these to another paper.
(3.31) $S = \sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\mu^2+\mu\nu+\nu^2} = 1 + 6\left(\frac{x}{1-x} - \frac{x^2}{1-x^2} + \frac{x^4}{1-x^4} - \frac{x^5}{1-x^5} + \cdots\right)$
(3.32) $S^2 = 1 + 12\left(\frac{x}{1-x} + \frac{2x^2}{1-x^2} + \frac{4x^4}{1-x^4} + \frac{5x^5}{1-x^5} + \cdots\right)$
(3.33) $S^3 = 1 - 9\left(\frac{1^2 x}{1-x} - \frac{2^2 x^2}{1-x^2} + \frac{4^2 x^4}{1-x^4} - \frac{5^2 x^5}{1-x^5} + \cdots\right)$
$+ 27\left(\frac{1^2 x}{1+x+x^2} + \frac{2^2 x^2}{1+x^2+x^4} + \frac{3^2 x^3}{1+x^3+x^6} + \cdots\right)$
(3.34) $S^4 = 1 + 24\left(\frac{1^3 x}{1-x} + \frac{2^3 x^2}{1-x^2} + \frac{3^3 x^3}{1-x^3} + \cdots\right)$
$+ 8\left(\frac{3^3 x^3}{1-x^3} + \frac{6^3 x^6}{1-x^6} + \frac{9^3 x^9}{1-x^9} + \cdots\right)$.
